text:
mira: FYI Arcadia Labs (mid-market) flagged they=re likely to move to pay-as-you-go at renewal. Main pain: unexpected invoice spike + no internal enablement (devs stalled). They said throughput is also lower than their benchmarks. Renewal in ~18 days. Need a concise save.

sam: Oof. Do we have raw usage + billing breakdown? Can finance surface the spike cause (token vs embedding vs retries)?

evelyn: I'll pull billing detail now. Suspect retries due to malformed payloads from their integration. Also they haven't finished the batching config we recommended.

tony: I can offer a short-term throttle/batching config and quick code walkthrough for their engs. 60m pairing session? I have windows tomorrow.

mira: Proposed play (short):
- Immediate "bill review" + one-off invoice adjustment if spike due to our SDK guidance gap (finance)
- 60m dev pairing to fix retries + batching (tony)
- 2-week expert enablement package (3x 30m check-ins)
- Conditional 20% invoice credit if they sign a 12-week engagement pact to complete enablement
- Capture feedback via structured form and route product tickets

sam: Keep the credit language time-limited and one-off. Tagging @cs-bot to open a billing investigation ticket.

cs-bot: Created ticket CS-#4981: "Arcadia Labs  billing spike investigation" assigned to finance-ops. SLA 24h.

evelyn: Billing shows a 3x spike on day 12 of trial period. Looks like repeated failed calls from their worker queue generated retries. I'll attach the sample logs to the ticket.

tony: For pairing: I will prepare a tiny demo repo showing proper exponential backoff + batching snippet:

```
// pseudo
const client = new Redwood({key: process.env.KEY});
await client.generate({batch: true, retry: {max:3, backoff: 500}});
```

mira: Messaging to customer (draft):

```
Hi Jordan,
Thanks for raising this. We dug into your account and see an unusual retry pattern that explains the spike. Proposed immediate steps: 1) we=ll run a free 60-minute dev pairing to address retries + batching; 2) we=ll run a billing review and apply a one-time credit if the spike ties to retries; 3) we=ll enroll your team in a short enablement track with weekly check-ins.
Can we book the pairing tomorrow? If helpful we can share a short runbook before the call.
Best, Mira (CSM)
```

evelyn: Add: please ask them to send 2 sample request IDs so we can correlate logs faster.

tony: I can be on the call tomorrow 11am ET. Will prep the repo and step checklist. :thumbsup:

mira: I'll send the note now. Also adding a structured feedback link for product so we capture their feature asks: https://internal.redwood/feedback/arcadia-quick

cs-bot: Note added to Arcadia Labs account  playbook "billing-rapid-inspect" applied.

mira: Customer replied: "11am ET works. We=re worried about costs but open to pairing. We'll bring two request IDs." 

sam: Great. Finance  ops: if spike maps to client-side retries we'll do a goodwill one-off credit and mark play as closed-won if they sign the 12-week enablement. Keep me posted.

evelyn: Logs attached to CS-#4981. Looks clearly like retry storms from a misconfigured worker backoff.

tony: Pairing completed. Fixed batching and backoff. They validated lower per-request token usage and retries stopped. Shared post-call checklist in the ticket.
mira: Outcome: immediate reduction in request volume and estimated monthly cost down ~42%. Customer asked for a time-limited reduced commitment option while they stabilize.
sam: We offer a 12-week enablement commitment with 20% one-time credit on the next invoice; if they stabilize early, we convert to standard renewal. Keep terms explicit in the deal doc.
mira: I'll close loop with them and get formal acceptance. Filing quick retrospective: this pattern = enablement gap + SDK guidance. Suggest a product doc update and a small push to docs for "batching and backoff" examples.

evelyn: Filing product ticket: PROD-#742: "Docs: batching/backoff examples for node/python SDKs".

mira: Thanks team. Small, fast technical plays + transparent billing fixes seem to be the win here. :rocket:
